_readme: ToTally — Cursor hook template. This file shows the hooks block to merge into ~/.cursor/hooks.json. Do NOT replace your entire hooks.json with this file — the installer merges only the 'hooks' entries that belong to ToTally. If you already have hooks for an event, the installer appends a new entry to that event's array. Cursor uses lower-camel event names and flat { "command": "..." } entries — this format is NOT the same as Claude Code's nested settings.json format.
